faq.q: When does sargassum season hit the Bahamas?
faq.a: Sargassum activity in the Bahamas varies by year, island and coastal exposure. East-facing Atlantic shores can differ from sheltered bays, and seasonal patterns are not a guarantee for any specific beach. A current beach status should appear only when a validated observation is available; otherwise, use the published timestamp and withhold a current recommendation.

faq.q: Do the Bahamas really get less sargassum than the rest of the Caribbean?
faq.a: No validated regional comparison is published for the Bahamas. Exposure can vary by island, beach orientation, date and cloud cover. Check the latest available observation and timestamp for the specific beach; no regional accuracy or cleanliness claim is made.

faq.q: Which Bahamas beaches stay free of sargassum?
faq.a: No beach is guaranteed free of sargassum, and this site does not publish a verified ranking of Bahamas beaches by exposure. Use the latest available observation and timestamp for each tracked beach. If data are delayed or unverified, the page withholds a current clean-beach recommendation.

faq.q: How accurate is this sargassum tracker?
faq.a: The public validation record currently covers Martinique and Guadeloupe. It does not establish forecast accuracy for the Bahamas. No regional accuracy percentage is claimed for this market until it is included in the record. Forecast confidence varies by horizon; the 7-day outlook is directional, not a verified accuracy guarantee.

faq.q: Can you really forecast sargassum a week out?
faq.a: A seven-day outlook is shown only when a recent observation and validated wind/current inputs are available. It is directional, not a guarantee of conditions on arrival, and no Bahamas-specific accuracy percentage is claimed until the public validation record covers this market. Beach persistence uses a provisional prior, not a measured universal clearance time.

faq.q: What should I do if my beach has sargassum?
faq.a: Compare the latest available observation for another tracked beach and read its timestamp and confidence. If the observation is delayed or unverified, do not treat the map as a current recommendation; check on-site conditions before travelling. Large rotting accumulations should be avoided.

forecast.title: Bahamas Sargassum Forecast — 7-Day Beach Outlook
forecast.desc: Beach-level sargassum outlook for tracked Bahamas beaches, shown only when the latest NOAA/AOML ERDDAP AFAI observation and validated environmental inputs are available. Check timestamps; no Bahamas-specific accuracy claim is made.
forecast.h1: Bahamas Sargassum Outlook — Beach by Beach
forecast.intro: This page organizes the latest available observations and directional outlooks for tracked Bahamas beaches. It does not assign one clean or avoid verdict to the entire region. A current beach status appears only when the observation passes freshness checks; otherwise the page withholds the decision and shows the available timestamp. Satellite observations can be affected by clouds and other measurement limitations, and they do not verify conditions on the sand.
forecast.method: The source is the USF Alternative Floating Algae Index (AFAI) distributed through NOAA/AOML ERDDAP. AFAI identifies floating-algae features; it can be limited by clouds, sun glint and thick aerosols, and it does not confirm beach conditions on the sand. A beach-level outlook is shown only when the observation and validated wind/current inputs pass freshness checks. The seven-day outlook is directional, not a verified accuracy guarantee for the Bahamas. Beach persistence uses a separate provisional prior, not a measured universal clearance time.

beachFaq._doc: Per-beach FAQPage JSON-LD templates. Consumed by region-seo-pages.cjs. Tokens, all resolved from public/api/copernicus/bahamas/sargassum.json at build time — never invented: {beach}=b.name, {status}=STATUS_WORD[lang][b.lv.status], {score}=b.lv.score, {today}=fmtDate(lang), {forecastLine}=forecastLine(data.weekly,b.id,lang), {nextArrival}=nextArrivalRisk with {day}/{date} of the first J+1..J+7 forecast day whose status!=='clean', else nextArrivalNone. Emit no FAQPage if live data is missing for the beach.

questions.a: Latest published observation for {beach}: {status} (Beach Score {score}/100), shown only when the observation passes freshness checks. The page displays the observation timestamp and confidence; if delayed or unverified, it withholds a current verdict. Open the map to inspect the source timestamp.
